verdict.rationale: Ramp documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients, with admin role and user restrictions, demo and multi-business endpoints, and two additional servers (Developer docs and Ramp Data). Live probes confirm a spec-compliant OAuth-gated endpoint publishing granular scopes and an unauthenticated developer MCP that answers initialize. Missing for 10: bill approvals are not yet available via MCP, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of actual tool calls beyond the auth and initialize handshakes.
